Villa drop legal action threat against Carragher
results.description: Aston Villa have dropped their threat of legal action against Sky Sports pundit Jamie Carragher. On Friday, Villa had said they would initiate legal action against the former England defender for what they described as “unacceptable insults” made by Carragher on the Stick to Football podcast.
